auth.authenticate.name: AuthenticateAsync
auth.authenticate.signature: Task<AuthenticateResponse> AuthenticateAsync(AuthenticateRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
auth.authenticate.summary: Authenticates to Verdocs and returns the session tokens. Call SetToken with the access token to apply it to this endpoint.

params.name: request
params.description: OAuth2 token request (password, client_credentials, refresh_token, or authorization_code).

throws.description: The API rejected the credentials or the call failed.

auth.getOAuth2AuthorizeUrl.name: GetOAuth2AuthorizeUrl
auth.getOAuth2AuthorizeUrl.summary: Builds the URL that starts an OAuth2 authorization code flow. Redirect the user's browser to this URL. After they authenticate and authorize, they land on redirect_uri with a code query parameter that AuthenticateAsync can exchange with grant_type authorization_code.

auth.refreshToken.name: RefreshTokenAsync
auth.refreshToken.signature: Task<AuthenticateResponse> RefreshTokenAsync(string refreshToken, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
auth.refreshToken.summary: Refreshes the caller's session and tokens before they expire.

params.name: refreshToken
params.description: The refresh token from a prior authenticate call.

throws.description: The refresh token was rejected or the call failed.

auth.changePassword.name: ChangePasswordAsync
auth.changePassword.signature: Task<ChangePasswordResponse> ChangePasswordAsync(ChangePasswordRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
auth.changePassword.summary: Updates the caller's password when the old password is known.

returns.description: Status and message from the server.

auth.resetPassword.name: ResetPasswordAsync
auth.resetPassword.signature: Task<ResetPasswordResponse> ResetPasswordAsync(ResetPasswordRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
auth.resetPassword.summary: Requests or completes a password reset when the old password is unknown. Omit code and new_password to start the reset; include both to finish it.

params.name: request
params.description: Email, and optionally the emailed code plus new password.

auth.resendVerification.name: ResendVerificationAsync
auth.resendVerification.signature: Task<ResendVerificationResponse> ResendVerificationAsync(string accessToken = null, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
auth.resendVerification.summary: Resends email verification for a partially authenticated user. Pass accessToken to identify the user when this endpoint is not already authenticated with that token.

params.name: accessToken
params.description: Optional bearer token used only for this request.

returns.description: Confirmation that the resend was queued.

auth.verifyEmail.name: VerifyEmailAsync
auth.verifyEmail.signature: Task<AuthenticateResponse> VerifyEmailAsync(VerifyEmailRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
auth.verifyEmail.summary: Verifies email when the user is unauthenticated but email and token are known.

auth.getMyUser.name: GetMyUserAsync
auth.getMyUser.summary: Gets the caller's current user record.

throws.description: The call failed, for example because the session is invalid.
